name: ContractRequestNegotiationTracker
tagline: The pre-signature contract pipeline – requests, redlines, clause deviations and approvals – in one Power Apps control.
description: Give the business one place to request contracts and give legal one place to run them: triage, drafting, internal review, redline rounds with ball-in-court tracking, clause deviations against the playbook, an approval matrix driven by value, risk, contract type and paper, signature and turnaround against targets. Dashboard, pipeline, board, clause heatmap and approval queue views; works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, starts with fictional demo data and connects to your contract request table in a few clicks.
features: Eleven-stage pre-signature workflow with allowed transitions and required fields
Redline rounds and ball-in-court tracking (legal, counterparty, business, approvers)
Clause deviation register with risk levels and accept / reject positions
Clause × risk heatmap across all open negotiations
Low-code approval matrix (value, deviation risk, type, paper, region)
Ready to sign blocked until approvals are complete and high-risk deviations resolved
Turnaround vs target per contract type, stale and overdue flags
Drag-and-drop board with keyboard Move to
Bulk assign, bulk move and CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
